zh.title: 日本空中通勤 ATR 72 出現駕駛盤不同步警示 折返鹿兒島
zh.summary: 日本空中通勤（JAC）JL3741 航班自鹿兒島起飛後，駕駛艙出現正、副駕駛駕駛盤不同步的警示，折返鹿兒島平安降落。航空公司表示實際並無故障。
body: 《The Aviation Herald》報導，日本空中通勤（Japan Air Commuter，JAC）一架 ATR 72-212A 於11月22日代日本航空執飛鹿兒島往屋久島的 JL3741 航班，機上共48人。飛機自鹿兒島機場34跑道起飛爬升時，機組收到正、副駕駛駕駛盤未同步作動的指示，但兩側駕駛盤看起來仍同步作動。涉事飛機註冊號為 JA08JC。
機組決定在1萬呎停止爬升並折返，起飛約45分鐘後平安降落鹿兒島。報導引述航空公司說法指出，機組收到正、副駕駛操縱裝置未同步的警示，實際上並無故障，飛機返回鹿兒島是為了交由維修人員檢查。
報導指出，飛機落地約16小時後仍停留在鹿兒島。

en.title: Japan Air Commuter ATR 72 returns to Kagoshima after control synchronisation alert
en.summary: Japan Air Commuter flight JL3741 returned to Kagoshima after the crew received an indication that the captain's and first officer's yokes were not moving in synchronisation. The airline said there was no malfunction.
body: The Aviation Herald reported that a Japan Air Commuter (JAC) ATR 72-212A was operating flight JL3741 from Kagoshima to Yakushima on behalf of Japan Airlines on November 22 with 48 people on board. While climbing out of Kagoshima's runway 34, the crew received an indication that the captain's and first officer's yokes were not moving in synchronisation, although the yokes appeared to move together. The aircraft was registered JA08JC.

The crew stopped the climb at 10,000 feet and returned to Kagoshima, where the aircraft landed safely about 45 minutes after departure. According to the report, the airline said the crew had received an alert that the two pilots' controls were not synchronised; there was no malfunction, and the aircraft returned for inspection by maintenance.
The aircraft was still on the ground in Kagoshima about 16 hours after landing, the report said.

facts.claim: JL3741, an ATR 72-212A registered JA08JC with 48 people on board, returned to Kagoshima on November 22 after an indication that the two yokes were not moving in synchronisation.
The aircraft stopped its climb at 10,000 feet and landed about 45 minutes after departure; the airline reported no malfunction.
The aircraft was still on the ground about 16 hours after landing.
